entries.title: I Chronicles 2:1
segments: ¶These [were] the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, Zebulun,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:2
segments: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:3
segments: The sons of Judah [were] Er, Onan, and Shelah. [These] three were born to him by the daughter of Shua, the Canaanitess. Er, the firstborn of Judah, was wicked in the sight of the LORD; so He killed him.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:4
segments: And Tamar, his daughter-in-law, bore him Perez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah [were] five.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:5
segments: The sons of Perez [were] Hezron and Hamul.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:6
segments: The sons of Zerah [were] Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara-five of them in all.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:7
segments: The son of Carmi [was] Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the accursed thing.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:8
segments: The son of Ethan [was] Azariah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:9
segments: Also the sons of Hezron who were born to him [were] Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:10
segments: Ram begot Amminadab, and Amminadab begot Nahshon, leader of the children of Judah;

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:11
segments: Nahshon begot Salma, and Salma begot Boaz;

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:12
segments: Boaz begot Obed, and Obed begot Jesse;

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:13
segments: Jesse begot Eliab his firstborn, Abinadab the second, Shimea the third,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:14
segments: Nethanel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:15
segments: Ozem the sixth, [and] David the seventh.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:16
segments: Now their sisters [were] Zeruiah and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah [were] Abishai, Joab, and Asahel-three.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:17
segments: Abigail bore Amasa; and the father of Amasa [was] Jether the Ishmaelite.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:18
segments: ¶Caleb the son of Hezron had children by Azubah, [his] wife, and by Jerioth. Now these were her sons: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:19
segments: When Azubah died, Caleb took Ephrath as his wife, who bore him Hur.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:20
segments: And Hur begot Uri, and Uri begot Bezalel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:21
segments: Now afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he [was] sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:22
segments: Segub begot Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:23
segments: (Geshur and Syria took from them the towns of Jair, with Kenath and its towns-sixty towns.) All these [belonged to] the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:24
segments: After Hezron died in Caleb Ephrathah, Hezron's wife Abijah bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:25
segments: The sons of Jerahmeel, the firstborn of Hezron, [were] Ram, the firstborn, and Bunah, Oren, Ozem, [and] Ahijah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:26
segments: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:27
segments: The sons of Ram, the firstborn of Jerahmeel, were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:28
segments: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai [were] Nadab and Abishur.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:29
segments: And the name of the wife of Abishur [was] Abihail, and she bore him Ahban and Molid.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:30
segments: The sons of Nadab [were] Seled and Appaim; Seled died without children.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:31
segments: The son of Appaim [was] Ishi, the son of Ishi [was] Sheshan, and Sheshan's child [was] Ahlai.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:32
segments: The sons of Jada, the brother of Shammai, [were] Jether and Jonathan; Jether died without children.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:33
segments: The sons of Jonathan [were] Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:34
segments: Now Sheshan had no sons, only daughters. And Sheshan had an Egyptian servant whose name [was] Jarha.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:35
segments: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife, and she bore him Attai.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:36
segments: Attai begot Nathan, and Nathan begot Zabad;

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:37
segments: Zabad begot Ephlal, and Ephlal begot Obed;

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:38
segments: Obed begot Jehu, and Jehu begot Azariah;

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:39
segments: Azariah begot Helez, and Helez begot Eleasah;

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:40
segments: Eleasah begot Sismai, and Sismai begot Shallum;

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:41
segments: Shallum begot Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begot Elishama.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:42
segments: The descendants of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel [were] Mesha, his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph, and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:43
segments: The sons of Hebron [were] Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:44
segments: Shema begot Raham the father of Jorkoam, and Rekem begot Shammai.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:45
segments: And the son of Shammai [was] Maon, and Maon [was] the father of Beth Zur.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:46
segments: Ephah, Caleb's concubine, bore Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran begot Gazez.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:47
segments: And the sons of Jahdai [were] Regem, Jotham, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:48
segments: Maachah, Caleb's concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:49
segments: She also bore Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah and the father of Gibea. And the daughter of Caleb [was] Achsah.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:50
segments: These were the descendants of Caleb: The sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, [were] Shobal the father of Kirjath Jearim,

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:51
segments: Salma the father of Bethlehem, [and] Hareph the father of Beth Gader.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:52
segments: And Shobal the father of Kirjath Jearim had descendants: Haroeh, [and] half of the [families of] Manuhoth.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:53
segments: The families of Kirjath Jearim [were] the Ithrites, the Puthites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites. From these came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:54
segments: The sons of Salma [were] Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Atroth Beth Joab, half of the Manahethites, and the Zorites.

entries.title: I Chronicles 2:55
segments: And the families of the scribes who dwelt at Jabez [were] the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, [and] the Suchathites. These [were] the Kenites who came from Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
